piles.label: Locutus's pile
piles.intro: Cards that fit the Borg deck better. Locutus makes a Borg token whenever an artifact creature connects, and the anthems, Borg Cube's affinity and the one-sided sweepers all count ARTIFACT CREATURES, so a card has to add to that count or pay off per artifact creature.

piles.label: Sisko's pile
piles.intro: Cards that fit the Sisko deck better. Sisko makes an Officer for every dilemma you face (each time you choose a mode for a spell or ability), so the best cards here make you choose modes every turn, or pay off per dilemma or per Officer.

piles.label: Fits neither
piles.intro: Cards that fit neither deck, each with the reason. Listed so nothing is silently dropped.

U.S.S. Enterprise-D, Galaxy-Class.text: A card to play each turn you charge it; 4/5 flier at 7. Borg: Spacecraft slots went to ones that interact. Sisko: Captain Picard's seven-Officer tap puts it in with 7 counters, i.e. already a creature.

Romulan Bird-of-Prey.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, Borg UPGRADED. Two charge counters per noncreature spell while it is not a creature. Borg's 19 noncreature spells also get it to 8 (and it then counts as an artifact creature for Borg). Sisko: about 30.

Oberth-Class Starship.text: Plains fetch on a 2-mana ship, flier at 6. Too little in either deck.

Entropic Battlecruiser.text: Discard drain; a 3/10 deathtouch flier at 8. Slow in both.

Deep Space 9.text: 9 mana: free permanents each upkeep, +3/+3 at 9 counters. Neither deck has the ramp for it.

H.M.S. Bounty, Unlikely Timeship.text: Whale tutor and extra turn; no Whale worth it in either deck.

Hologram Janeway.text: An artifact creature (Borg count) AND an Officer (Sisko's free-cast count). Counter on attack at 8+ power.

Seven of Nine, Unassimilated.text: Draws every turn; the discard stops at five differently named lands. Sisko's singleton five-colour manabase has 30+ names, so it is a free card a turn, and she is an Officer. In Borg she is also an artifact creature.

Noctis, Prince of Lucis.text: Casts artifacts from the graveyard for 3 extra life (finality counter); strong recursion in the artifact deck, little in Sisko.

Dominion Saboteur.text: Copies a creature or a charged Spacecraft with its counters. Fine in either.

Georgiou, Terran Emperor.text: A card a turn for 3 life. In Sisko the downside is an upside: at 0 life she makes ten Officers, and Sisko's free-cast reads Officers. Risky if she dies.

The Measure of a Man.text: Saga, NOT modal (no dilemma): temporary exile + Clue, or blink your own enter trigger.

Set Phasers to . . ..text: IN deck 101. 1-mana modal (a dilemma) stun or 3 to an attacker.

Test of Priorities.text: IN deck 101. Modal instant: draw, or blink a creature to dodge removal; a dilemma either way.

Hemmer, Fixing What Is Broken.text: Spacecraft hexproof on your turn; loots whenever tapped (station taps it). Borg runs 8 Spacecraft, Sisko 3.

Live Long and Prosper.text: 7 mana: double your life and draw a hand.

Adagia, Windswept Bastion.text: W Planet; at 12 counters copies an artifact (Borg Cube, Conquest Mission).

Susur Secundi, Void Altar.text: B Planet; card draw by sacrifice at 12.

Lost Jitte.text: Equip 1. Each counter removed is a MODAL activation (untap a land / can't block / +1/+1), so in Sisko every counter is a dilemma and an Officer. Fine in Borg on an evasive drone.

Engineered Explosives.text: Sunburst sweeper; symmetric, and it kills Sisko's own Officers.

Excalibur II.text: Grows with lifegain; neither deck gains enough.

Workshop Elders.text: 7 mana: artifact creatures fly; animates a noncreature artifact each combat.

Salvation Engine.text: OWNED. +2/+2 anthem Vehicle that returns an artifact each attack; crew 6.

Unctus, Grand Metatect.text: +1/+1 to other artifact creatures; loots for blue creatures that tap.

Brokers' Safeguard.text: Protects only a NONartifact creature: little in Borg, but in Sisko it blinks Sisko or Picard with a permanent shield counter.

Mr. Spock, Science Officer.text: IN deck 100. Every draw becomes two: in Sisko that doubles Seven of Nine's per-dilemma draw, Make It So and the Tests. Pick a home for variety.

Consider the Prime Directive.text: IN deck 100. Modal counter or stun-and-draw; a dilemma in Sisko.

Malfunctioning Holodeck.text: IN deck 100. Ward-2 O-ring that answers any nonland permanent.

Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.text: IN deck 100. Drains per opposing draw, gains per your draw. Fine in either.

Shields Up!.text: IN deck 100. Hexproof + indestructible on an artifact or creature.

Flare of Fortitude.text: IN deck 100. Free turn of protection for the team.

Mirror Universe Intrusion.text: IN deck 100. Copies their best creature.

U.S.S. Excelsior, Cutting Edge.text: IN deck 100. ETB destroys a tapped creature; flier when stationed.

Susurian Dirgecraft.text: IN deck 100. ETB edict; flier at 7.

Jett Reno, Problem Solver.text: IN deck 101. A counter per dilemma; draws when tapped at power 4+. In Borg, station taps her every turn.

Three Steps Ahead.text: IN deck 101. Spree counter / copy an artifact or creature / loot. Copying Borg Cube or a Queen is strong in Borg.

Sublime Epiphany.text: IN deck 101. Choose-one-or-more counter, bounce, copy, draw.

Silumgar's Command.text: IN deck 101. Two of counter / bounce / -3/-3 / kill a planeswalker. Esper-castable.

Black Market Connections.text: IN deck 101. Choose one or more each main phase: in Sisko a dilemma every turn. In Borg just card flow (its Shapeshifters are not artifacts).

Silverback Elder.text: A dilemma per creature spell, plus land ramp or artifact/enchantment removal. Cut for {G}{G}{G}: 42% on turn 5 in five colours. Gala Greeters took the slot.

Vraska's Final Mercy.text: Kill spell, modal. {B}{B} cast on turn 2 only 47% of the time; Deadly Plot took the slot.

Tectonic Giant.text: Modal trigger on each attack. {R}{R} on turn 4 is 60%; Territorial Kavu (domain, also modal on attack) took the slot.

Ojutai Exemplars.text: A dilemma per noncreature spell (tap / first strike + lifelink / blink). {W}{W}.

Operations Officer.text: An Officer that draws on entry and grows on attack.

Kirk, Commanding Officer.text: Officer; impulse card each attack at 8+ power; sacrifices to kill an artifact or enchantment.

Kirk, Enterprising Captain.text: Officer, menace; impulse at 8+ power. Weaker than Captain James T. Kirk.

Collective Brutality.text: Escalate modal: -2/-2, take an instant/sorcery, drain 2. One dilemma per cast.

Collective Defiance.text: Escalate modal burn: 4 to a creature, 3 to the opponent, wheel a hand. {R}{R}.

Insatiable Avarice.text: Spree tutor-to-top or draw three; a dilemma.

Sylvan Scavenging.text: OWNED. End-step modal (counter or a 3/3). One dilemma a turn; slower than Felidar Retreat.

Retreat to Kazandu.text: Landfall modal: counter or 2 life. A dilemma per land, but weaker than Felidar Retreat.

Abiding Grace.text: End-step modal: 1 life or return a 1-drop. Stack it before Sisko's trigger.

Sune's Intervention.text: 6-mana choose-one-or-more: two Knights, seek, artifact/enchantment removal.

Silent Hallcreeper.text: OWNED. Unblockable; modal on each hit.

Smuggler's Surprise.text: Spree: dig, cheat two creatures in, or protect big creatures.

Gabriel Lorca, Mirror Menace.text: Officer that returns from the graveyard per dilemma for {B}.

Loot, the Key to Everything.text: Exiles cards per card type on the board each upkeep.

Drill Too Deep.text: Modal: five charge counters or destroy an artifact.

Archenemy's Charm.text: Modal exile / recursion. {B}{B}{B} in five colours.

Drown in the Loch.text: Modal counter or kill, scaled by THEIR graveyard; slow in 1v1.

Orzhov Charm.text: Modal: bounce your own, kill (lose life), return a 1-drop.

Final Showdown.text: OWNED. Spree; the wipe mode kills Sisko's Officers too.

Golgari Charm.text: -1/-1 to all kills Sisko's own Officers.

Gix's Command.text: Destroys each creature with power 2 or less: Sisko's Officers.

Sandsteppe Citadel.text: Tapped tri-land. Untapped pathways measured better: 42.4% vs 41.2% average on-curve chance.

Frontier Bivouac.text: Tapped tri-land; replaced by a pathway (see Sandsteppe Citadel).

Nomad Outpost.text: Tapped tri-land; replaced by a pathway.

The World Tree.text: Tapped G land, any colour at six lands. Replaced by a pathway.

Sarek, Federation Ambassador.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, CORRECTED. The earlier note said Officer tokens give only one type, but Sarek counts TYPES across all your non-Borg creatures, and Sisko's nontoken creatures carry many (Human, Officer, Cardassian, Rogue, Romulan, Spy, Artificer, Elemental, Kavu, Elf…). Four or five creatures on board reach 10 types, so 2 cards a combat. Green-white-blue, not legal in Borg.

Bringer of the White Dawn.text: WUBRG alt cost; returns an artifact each upkeep.

Expropriate.text: Council's dilemma is a VOTE, not a mode choice, so it makes no Officer. 9 mana.

Kobayashi Maru Scenario.text: One mode is 'You lose the game' and each mode can be chosen only once: the fourth upkeep loses.

Demonic Pact.text: Same lose-the-game mode as Kobayashi Maru.

Impossible Choice.text: Owner's removal rule: the kill mode gives the opponent two Officers.

Scotty, Miracle Worker.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. During your main phase every instant and sorcery in your graveyard can be recast for its mana cost by returning another creature to hand. Sisko: return an Officer token (it is replaced at end step) to recast a charm or command, and each recast is a NEW dilemma, so a new Officer. About 30 of the deck's spells qualify. Borg: about 13 removal spells to recast, returning a Borg token.

Isshin, Two Heavens as One.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. Attack triggers trigger twice. Sisko runs five modal attack triggers (Captain James T. Kirk, Tal Shiar Operative, Elder Gargaroth, Territorial Kavu, Warren Warleader): each one becomes TWO dilemmas, so two Officers. Red-white-black identity, so not legal in Borg.

Rimefire Torque.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. Choose a creature type: a charge counter per permanent of that type entering; remove three to copy your next instant or sorcery that turn. Sisko names Officer (several enter every end step); Borg names Borg (Locutus and the token makers). Roughly a copy per turn in either deck. A copy keeps its modes but is not cast, so it is not a dilemma.

Anthropological Mission.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. A loot per noncreature spell, then a pure draw once it has three quest counters. Sisko casts about 32 noncreature spells, so it is a card a spell by turn 6. Borg has about 19.

Suus Mahna Practitioner.text: Re-read 2026-11-12. The tap ability costs {4}{U} minus one per differently named land. Both decks run 30+ land names, so it is a repeatable {U} tapper by turn 5. An Officer for Sisko.

Sarcophagus, Ship of the Dead.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. +1/+0 to your other creatures even before it is a creature: an anthem for Sisko's Officer tokens, stacking with Captain Picard. Red, not legal in Borg.

Mikaeus, the Lunarch.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED. Taps to put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature: in Sisko that grows the whole Officer swarm each turn.

U.S.S. Voyager, Lone Wanderer.text: Re-read 2026-11-12. Puts two lands onto the battlefield on entry: ramp, and two Felidar Retreat triggers, so two dilemmas. Green, not legal in Borg.

David and Carol Marcus, Creators.text: Re-read 2026-11-12. A body plus an any-colour New Planet land token. The token entering triggers Felidar Retreat (a dilemma). Green, not legal in Borg.

Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain.text: Re-read 2026-11-12. Draws per historic spell. Sisko casts about 22 legendaries, artifacts and Sagas. Blue-red, not legal in Borg (where every artifact would draw).

Brad Boimler, Eager Ensign.text: Re-read 2026-11-12, UPGRADED for Borg. Tapping him to station adds one extra charge counter (the counters land while he is tapped), and +1/+1 counters likewise. A 2-mana station booster beside Zefram and Warp Core.

Iron Man, Modern Marvel.text: OWNED. Flier; other artifact creatures +1/+1; draws a card each attack while you control another artifact creature. Proposed for Free Borg Revolutionaries.

Doctor Doom.text: OWNED. Two 3/3 Doombot artifact creature tokens on entry, a card every end step, and indestructible while you control an artifact creature. Proposed for Badgey.

Chrome Dome.text: OWNED. 2-mana artifact creature: other artifact creatures +1/+0, and {5} copies an artifact for a turn (Borg Cube, a Queen). Proposed for Data, New Life.

Arcbound Condor.text: Flying artifact creature, modular 3; -1/-1 to an opposing creature whenever another artifact enters (every Borg token). Repeatable removal, so it replaces Make Disappear without dropping interaction.

Kappa Cannoneer.text: Improvise, ward 4; a +1/+1 counter and unblockable whenever another artifact enters. Proposed for Lita (her end-step untap is redundant with Command Subadjunct's vigilance).

Thought Monitor.text: Affinity for artifacts: often {U} or {1}{U} here; a 2/2 flying artifact creature that draws two. Proposed for Mind Stone.

Angel of Invention.text: +1/+1 to all your other creatures plus two Servo artifact creatures or a 4/3 flying lifelink; {3}{W}{W}. An option if you want a fourth anthem.

Krang, Utrom Warlord.text: SPICE, OWNED. 9 mana, but every artifact creature gains flying, trample, indestructible and haste: one swing ends the game. Proposed for Sharding Sphinx.

Virulent Silencer.text: SPICE, OWNED. Two poison per hit by a NONTOKEN artifact creature: a second clock. Borg tokens do not count.

Karn's Bastion.text: SPICE. Land: {4},{T}: proliferate, adding charge counters to every Spacecraft and +1/+1 counters to Steel Overseer and Kappa Cannoneer. Colourless: it cost about 1.4 points of average on-curve chance when tested for a Swamp.

Alela, Artful Provocateur.text: SPICE. Flying deathtouch lifelink; a 1/1 flying Faerie per artifact spell, and +1/+0 to your fliers. The Faeries are not artifacts.

Monoist Circuit-Feeder.text: 6-mana flying artifact creature: on entry, -0/-X to an opposing creature where X is your artifact count (usually lethal).
